title: Pull config reading into one module
prompt: src/db.js, src/mailer.js and src/server.js each read their own APP_* environment variables with defaults. Create src/config.js exporting loadConfig(env = process.env) that returns { dbUrl, mailFrom, port } (port as a number) using the same variables and defaults, and make all three modules get their values from it instead of reading process.env themselves. Nothing else should change.
